holidays.name: National Awkward Moments Day
holidays.description: This day is for the stumbles, the wrong-person waves, the accidental "you too!" replies to a waiter who said "enjoy your meal," and every other cringe-worthy moment. Today you're encouraged to laugh at your own social blunders instead of replaying them at 3 a.m.
holidays.origin: It's an unofficial, lighthearted observance, and its creator is unclear. It has become a yearly excuse to share embarrassing stories and laugh about them together.
holidays.funFact: Psychologists call the intense embarrassment you feel replaying an awkward moment the "spotlight effect". People notice your blunders far less than you think they do.

holidays.name: National Lacy Oatmeal Cookie Day
holidays.description: This day honors the thin, crisp, caramelized oatmeal cookie with delicate holes that look like edible lace. They are buttery and chewy at the center, with crunchy edges. Some bakers even roll them around a spoon handle or sandwich them with chocolate.
holidays.origin: It's an unofficial food observance of unclear origin. It celebrates a classic old-fashioned cookie that spreads out into a thin, lacy shape as it bakes.
holidays.funFact: Lacy oatmeal cookies get their see-through look because the batter is very loose. It spreads thin on the pan, so you have to leave plenty of space between cookies.

holidays.name: Global Recycling Day
holidays.description: This day shines a spotlight on recycling and on the "seventh resource", the recyclable materials that join water, air, fire, earth, plants and animals as things the planet depends on. People mark it with cleanups, sorting challenges and a hard look at what's in their trash cans.
holidays.origin: The Global Recycling Foundation, part of the Bureau of International Recycling, launched the day in 2018. It aims to get people and governments around the world to treat recycling as a valuable resource.
holidays.funFact: Aluminum cans can be recycled over and over without losing quality. A recycled can can be back on a store shelf in about 60 days.
